text:
Anika (CEO): Quick post-AH notes from my side 1- thank you for the strong turnout. Sharing clarifications, links, and owners so nothing slips through. Slides + recording: https://redwood.ai/ah/2026-03-23-brief (org).

Priya (VP Product): Can we clarify the timeline for the public SDK updates and the policy on deprecating old endpoints? A few folks asked.

Devon (CTO): SDK updates: beta SDKs next week (2026-03-30), GA in 6 weeks (2026-05-11). Deprecation policy: 90 days notice + migration guides for any breaking changes.

Noah (Infra): For Dedicated rollout: infra will enable multi-az in pilot regions. Need product to confirm retry/backoff defaults we should bake into the client.

Priya (VP Product): Default client behaviors: exponential backoff with jitter, max retries = 3, and a transparent 429 hint header. We'll add to SDK release notes.

Leah (Customer Success): Customers asked about onboarding support levels for pilot vs GA. Are we offering white-glove pilot support?

Anika (CEO): Yes, pilot customers get priority onboarding (two sessions + one concierge week). GA support tiers roll out with the pricing page. Leah, coordinate with Sales for scheduling.

ops-bot: Event created: "AH follow-ups: SDK & Dedicated runbook sync" 2026-03-31 09:00 PST.

Action items (short):
- Devon (CTO) -> publish SDK beta and release notes (2026-03-30) (#JIRA-3210)
- Priya (VP Product) -> add deprecation policy + migration guide template (2026-04-04) (#JIRA-3211)
- Noah (Infra) -> enable multi-az pilot infra and confirm retry defaults in infra repo (2026-04-07) (#JIRA-3212)
- Leah (Customer Success) -> draft pilot onboarding ops playbook and schedule first onboarding session (2026-04-02) (#JIRA-3213)

Devon (CTO): I'll post the SDK branch link in #devex and ping maintainers for reviews.

Priya (VP Product): If anyone has conflicts on due dates, please flag before 2026-03-27.

Anika (CEO): Thanks all. We'll revisit progress in leadership sync next week. :sparkles:
